changes: Added story_review.planReviewRound as the explicit numeric PLAN review count, kept story_review.reviewRound as a legacy numeric alias, documented the distinction from signed artifact reviewRound, and added smoke/contract assertions for the schema split.
usage: Run koala story_review for PLAN review JSON; read planReviewRound for the numeric PLAN review count. Treat finding/review pass/delivery reviewRound as ISO 8601 signed artifact state.
expectedOutcome: Maintainer sees story_review output with planReviewRound as a number, while docs and tests still show signed artifact reviewRound as an ISO 8601 string.
actualTranscript: node scripts/verify-story-review-structured-output.mjs printed story review structured output verified; npm run test:field-regression-cli-smoke printed field regression CLI smoke passed; npm run test:process-fact-contract printed Process fact contract verified.
outcomeDiff: No gap: expected numeric PLAN round and signed ISO reviewRound distinction is visible in output, docs, and tests.
limitations: Compatibility alias story_review.reviewRound remains for old callers; new callers should use planReviewRound.
pitfalls: Initial evidence overclaimed signed reviewRound coverage; test-coverage reviewer caught it, so field-regression smoke now directly checks CLI-created finding/review pass reviewRound equals story.currentReviewRound.
